title: Key Moments — White Shoppers & Bus Explosion

flashcard_questions.q: The area of the stage directly in the middle, visible to the entire audience. Abbreviated as CS.
The physical distance between performers on stage, used to show relationships, power dynamics, or emotional connections between characters.
When two or more performers speak the same lines at the same time, often used to show shared beliefs or lack of independent thought.

flashcard_questions.a: A broad spread of light covering a large area of the stage, used to create atmosphere or establish a general mood.
The point of highest dramatic tension or intensity in a performance, where the conflict reaches its peak.
